ideas.pitch: An interactive web debugger for visualizing complex array algorithms like sliding windows and monotonic stacks in real-time.
ideas.title: AlgoVisualizer: Monotonic Stack & Sliding Window Lab
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the assessment's focus on foundational computer science concepts (Arrays, Sliding Window, Monotonic Stack) and provides immediate educational utility for technical screening preparation.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight sandbox tool for testing REST API requests, HTTP headers, and debugging strict CORS policies directly in the browser.
ideas.title: RestCorsInspector: Client-Side API & Header Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core web development assessment themes of HTTP, REST APIs, and CORS mechanics through an interactive utility.

ideas.pitch: An in-browser educational sandbox for experimenting with C++ pointers, references, virtual tables, polymorphism, and STL containers.
ideas.title: CppPointersPlayground: STL & Memory Management Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the heavy emphasis on C++ fundamental concepts (Pointers, References, OOP, Polymorphism, STL) evaluated in Section C of the technical assessment.

ideas.pitch: A modular quiz and coding assessment engine designed to test algorithmic logic, multiple-choice concepts, and memory management under strict time limits.
ideas.title: AssessmentMockEngine: Technical Evaluation Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact structure of the Technical Team Online Assessment format (90-minute timed testing across multiple technical sections).

ideas.pitch: A developer tool that tracks memory allocation and execution steps for array and stack-based algorithms to verify algorithmic efficiency.
ideas.title: StackScope: Algorithmic Complexity and Memory Tracer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to judges evaluating efficient solutions and fundamental programming knowledge by providing hard proof of performance constraints.
